name: fable-advisor
description: A small control plane for delegation: implementation goes to the Codex lane (GPT-5.6 Luna) by default, because Claude quota is the scarce resource your reasoning, review and integration consume, and work stays Claude-side only for one of five named reasons. Every lane runs in a disposable git worktree, so a lane cannot reach the main tree or another lane's uncommitted work and undoing one is a worktree removal rather than a checkout. Also ships a model-parameterized Claude-side implementer (haiku/sonnet/fable, chosen on the spawn) and a read-only Fable 5 reviewer used in proportion to blast radius, with the silence-gap check for defects of omission and a two-pass review that keeps the reviewer from inheriting the implementer's claims.
